responses.greeting:
🎓 Welcome to Student Attendance Tracker!

I'll help you track your attendance for all subjects.
Let's get started! What's your name?
responses.name_saved:
Nice to meet you, {name}! 😊

Ready to track your attendance?
responses.subject_selected:
{icon} {subject} selected!

What would you like to do?
• Say 'present' to mark attendance
• Say 'absent' if you missed class
• Say 'percentage' to check attendance
• Say 'record' to view history
• Say 'change' to select another subject
responses.no_subject: ⚠️ Please select a subject first! Say a subject name or number (1-6).
responses.thank_you: You're welcome, {name}! Keep up the good attendance! 🎓

messages.action_menu:
✨ What's next?
• Mark another subject (say subject name)
• Check 'percentage'
• View 'record' (all subjects)
• View 'all subjects' summary
• Say 'menu' to see subjects again
messages.help:
